nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing contributor guide documenting authoritative sources, REGOS API and webhook conventions, integration code style, code-review checklist, and README conventions for the integrations service.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project README (in Russian) explaining how to work with the repository (main/dev branches), how to add a new REGOS API-wrapper service, how to add and register a new client integration, project standards, and debugging/logging guidance.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Russian; covers branch workflow and step-by-step recipes for extending REGOS API wrappers and registering new integrations.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python dependency manifest pinning the runtime libraries for the FastAPI gateway: fastapi/uvicorn, httpx/aiohttp/requests, redis, asyncmy (MySQL), aiogram (Telegram), aiosmtplib, pydantic-settings, and document/image helpers (qrcode, pillow, openpyxl).
